services.name: Offshore Fishing
services.desc: Booking a charter fishing trip with Salt Fin Charters is one of the best ways to experience the beautiful waters of the South Carolina Lowcountry. Each trip is private for your group, and we customize the fishing plan based on the season, conditions, and the species you’d like to target. Whether you have a deep-sea fishing trip in mind or prefer to stay in shallow water, our fun and experienced captain and crew are excited to welcome you aboard for an unforgettable day of fishing! Duration: 4-5 HoursPrice: $700Guests: Up to 4 included (up to 6 with additional guest

The boat is a 2016 35ST Contender with three Yamaha 300 four-stroke motors and modern navigation and safety equipment.
